events.verdict: Bane (MEM) places his off-arm against Daniels (ATL), whose momentum carries him forwards as Bane steps back.

Replay review of the foul called on Young (ATL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Young (ATL) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in Wells' (MEM) path prior to the start of his upward shooting motion and is dislodged from his position.
Wells (MEM) maintains a legal guarding position defending Daniels (ATL) on the perimeter.
Edey (MEM) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during LeVert's (ATL) driving shot attempt.
Bane (MEM) slides his pivot foot prior to releasing the ball.
Wells (MEM) and Okongwu (ATL) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
LeVert (ATL) extends his arm forward and initiates contact to Kennard (MEM) that affects his SQBR.
LeVert (ATL) makes contact with the ball to cause it to become loose and the ensuing contact with WIlliams Jr.'s (MEM) arm is marginal.
Daniels (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Bane (MEM) prior to any incidental arm contact occurring.
LeVert (ATL) gathers the pass on his right foot and legally takes two steps to the basket.
Williams Jr. (MEM) legally contests LeVert's (ATL) layup attempt.
